subject: Post-call: Bluewave procurement onramp + sprint plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Brooks <emma@bluewave-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Bluewave procurement onramp + sprint plan

Hi Emma — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on procurement path and timelines:

Key points from call:
- Bluewave is leaning toward a PO for production (preferred for finance controls). Card is possible for initial POC if procurement needs to move faster.
- Security will want a short evidence package (SOC 2 summary, network architecture, data retention controls).
- Legal indicated standard Redwood MPA + SOW will be fine, but they’ll need to review a draft.

My suggested mutual action plan (high level):
1) Redwood to send draft SOW and a short security snapshot (attached). (Owner: Redwood)
2) Bluewave security kickoff review (target 1 week after receipt). (Owner: Bluewave)
3) Legal review of MPA/SOW (2–3 business days internal review). (Owner: Bluewave legal)
4) Finance issues PO / or chooses card/marketplace route (target by first week of September). (Owner: Bluewave finance)

Attachments: draft SOW + security snapshot + pricing summary (I attached the 1-pager and the SOW template).

As next steps, can you confirm:
- PO vs card preference (I heard PO but wanted to confirm)
- Who needs to be on the security call (names/emails)
- Any internal timing constraints (procurement blackout windows, monthly cutoffs)

I’ll loop Ben and Soojin internally to prepare the SOW and a suggested sprint plan for procurement milestones. Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
From: Emma Brooks <emma@bluewave-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Chen <p.chen@bluewave-analytics.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Bluewave procurement onramp + sprint plan

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few things from our side:

- PO is preferred for production; card could be used for a two-week POC we plan in late Aug, but finance generally requires PO for any multi-month commitment.
- Security: I’ll loop in our InfoSec lead, Paul Chen (cc’d). He’ll want the SOC 2 summary and the network/ingress model.
- Timeline: legal and security typically run in parallel here. Expect legal to take ~3 business days for initial reading; security might take up to 7 business days depending on evidence requests. Our goal is to have PO issued by the week of Sep 1 if all reviews go smoothly.

Questions for Redwood:
1) Do you have a one-page security snapshot we can give to Paul immediately?
2) If we need to expedite, do you support marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace) to allow card initially and then convert to a PO?

Happy to jump on a quick 15-min sync with Paul + your security contact next week if helpful.

—Emma
Emma Brooks
Head of IT Operations, Bluewave Analytics
emma@bluewave-analytics.com | +1 (617) 555-0192

- Ben: draft a concise SOW (scope + ramp milestones) and a pricing pivot table (PO vs card vs marketplace) — attach a redline-friendly SOW PDF.
- Soojin: assemble the security one-pager + the SOC 2 summary and a short checklist of possible evidence items (network diagram, data flows, retention policy).

Goals: produce the SOW + security packet by EOD Wed (26 Aug) so Emma can circulate to Paul and legal. I’ll propose a 20-min sync with Paul and our security engineer once materials are live.

Attachments I’m including: pricing-summary.csv (for context).

Thanks — Marissa

Thanks — attaching the first-pass SOW (Redwood_SOW-draft.pdf) and a quick procurement sprint with owner/responsibility split. High-level timeline I recommend based on their target PO week (week of Sep 1):

Milestones (proposed):
- Thu 26 Aug: Redwood sends SOW + security packet (owner: Redwood) 
- Mon 30 Aug: Bluewave legal initial read (owner: Bluewave legal) — target 2 business days for comments
- Tue 31 Aug: Security Q&A kickoff (owner: Bluewave security + Redwood security) — target 3 business days to triage controls and evidence requests
- Wed 1 Sep: Final legal redline received (owner: Bluewave legal)
- Thu 2 Sep: Finance issues PO or confirms marketplace/card route (owner: Bluewave finance)

Notes / risk register:
- If security requests deeper evidence (full SOC 2 report or penetration test artifacts), timeline could slip by 5–10 business days.
- Marketplace route (AWS Marketplace) is a valid acceleration: card payment can be used for initial months and later converted to a PO for subscription commitments; we can provide marketplace SKU and procurement instructions if they prefer.

Action items for us now:
- Soojin: finalize security one-pager and SOC 2 excerpt.
- Hannah: I’m cc’ing you for legal support — please stand by to convert the SOW to our standard MPA + SOW bundle if Bluewave legal asks for it.

I’ll also add short language about data residency and retention into the SOW per their ask.

--
Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Emma — looping back with the mutually agreed sprint plan and explicit dates so we can lock the PO target on your side. If anything below looks off, tell me and I’ll update and resend to your legal/procurement owners.

Mutual action plan (finalized):
- 2026-08-26: Redwood -> SOW + security packet (done). Attachments: Redwood_SOW-draft.pdf, security-questionnaire-responses.xlsx
- 2026-08-30: Bluewave legal initial read
- 2026-08-31: Security kickoff (Paul + Redwood security)
- 2026-09-01: Final legal redlines (target)
- 2026-09-02: Finance issues PO (target) — alternate: Bluewave provisions via AWS Marketplace / card and converts to PO within 30 days

Ask: can you confirm who in finance signs the PO (name + email) so we can reference it on our invoice and acceptance gates? Also, if Paul needs any additional artifacts beforehand, point him to the Drive folder and I’ll upload the expanded docs.

If PO stays on track for Sep 2 we will prioritize provisioning and schedule a short kickoff for the POC week of Sep 6.

Thanks — looking forward to this.

Best,
Marissa
